_readme: Your watched films, in your own order of liking (rank 1 = liked most).
Edit anything here, then run: python .research/generate_page.py   and republish.
You can also edit rank, grade and reason directly on the published page — it saves itself.
grade: A B C D E F, optionally with + or - (A-, B+). Leave "" if undecided.
reason: one short line on why. Shown under the title.
filmId: links to a film on the 2026 Trello board. null means it was never on the board,
in which case director / release / url on the entry supply its details.
